inlines.v: DICHOTOMY, noun [Gr., a division into two parts; to cut.] 1. Division or distribution of ideas by pairs. [Little used.] 2. In astronomy, that phase of the moon in which it appears bisected, or shows only half its disk, as at the quadratures.
